terminus.candidate: The prior access-regime line was too one-sided. A Taichung TDR study treats location, carrying capacity, transport and spatial concentration as causally consequential, while also showing that regulatory design shapes where pressure accumulates.
terminus.revision: Use a narrower working hypothesis: outcomes are co-produced by access/regulatory regimes and the material-spatial capacities of locations; neither side should be treated as universally prior.
